# SPD-001 — Toy doc docs/toy/potato.md (History + Varieties): first end-to-end protocol test

## Brief
Eric wants `docs/toy/potato.md` with two sections, `History` and `Varieties`. Each section is written by a separate sub-agent of a lead; the lead merges both into the one file. The ticket doubles as the first end-to-end test of the spudagent protocol, with two verification wrinkles written into the sub-agent briefs:

1. The `Varieties` writer is told that `docs/toy` has no index page and must treat that as out-of-scope work: propose a ticket for it, do not build it.
2. The `History` writer is told to attempt to spawn one scout sub-agent of its own to look up a single date, so we see what the Agent tool does at the depth limit, and to log verbatim whatever the tool says.

Done when: `docs/toy/potato.md` exists with both sections merged by the lead; both wrinkles have produced a recorded observation (a proposal that climbed to Spud, and a logged depth-limit result); every team member has an Outcome; board and report are updated; the work is committed.

## Size, persona and model decision
Large: a lead with a team of two, because the two sections are genuinely separable and Eric asked for exactly that shape.

- Lead: writer persona. **Tier override: opus instead of sonnet.** Reason: this is the first end-to-end run of the protocol, and the lead's real job is protocol fidelity (IDs, files, briefs carrying the two test wrinkles, proposal escalation, merge), which is expensive if fumbled. The prose itself is trivial.
- Children: writer persona, sonnet (default tier). Both sections are short toy prose. Part of the test is whether a sonnet writer follows the protocol unaided, so no override.
- The History writer's scout attempt (scout, haiku) is expected to be refused at depth 3 (`max_depth: 2`, `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=2`). The attempt is the point.

Concurrency: 1 lead + 2 children (+ 1 scout if the cap does not fire) = at most 4 of 9.

## Outcome
Shipped `docs/toy/potato.md`: `# Potato`, one-sentence intro, `## History`, `## Varieties`, both sections written by separate sonnet writers and merged verbatim by the opus lead. Verified by Spud: file read in full, `git status` shows only `docs/toy/potato.md` outside the ledger, all four team files consistent (IDs, parents, nesting, Outcomes).

Both verification wrinkles produced their observation:
- **Depth limit:** cap held at `max_depth: 2`. Enforcement is tool removal, not refusal. Verbatim: `Error: No such tool available: Agent. Agent is disabled for this session, in subagents as well as here.` The message misdescribes the session (level 1 could spawn), and the standing protocol text in `.claude/agents/spudagent.md` describes a refusal no spudagent will see.
- **Proposal climb:** Rosara built nothing, proposed once, Kestrel escalated with origin, Spud created [[SPD-002]].

Two further findings from the run, both in [[SPD-003]]: the `status`/`finished` ownership contradiction between CLAUDE.md and the agent definition (every team member self-marked done), and guessed timestamps (all in the future; nobody ran `date`). Kestrel also disclosed and self-corrected a pre-written Log before spawning.

Left: nothing on this ticket. [[SPD-002]] and [[SPD-003]] are queued.
